entries.title: NightCry

emulation.emulator: Native Windows PC; Vita3K only for Vita-version comparison
emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for the primary route. Vita emulation is unnecessary unless comparing the portable port.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.why: NightCry is a Clock Tower spiritual successor rather than a direct Clock Tower sequel; the Windows PC/Steam release is the highest-fidelity and most accessible route, while the PS Vita version is a later portable port.
primary.how_to_play: Buy NightCry on Steam or through Playism's official listing, and look into compatibility tweaks if needed. Use the PS Vita version only for portability.

all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity, capture, and access route with no sourced content loss versus Vita.
skip: portability option, but no sourced exclusive content or fidelity advantage over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content split was identified between PC and Vita.

entries.remaster_caveats: NightCry is a spiritual successor to Clock Tower, not an official Clock Tower sequel or remaster.
